posts.author: Aprimachi
posts.body:
Hello all,
I've been lurking for a while now while working on my first real game project, and just thought it would be nice to introduce myself to connect a bit with the community.
I'm Apri, an office lady in her early 30s who recently re-discovered her RPG Maker humble bundle purchase from some years ago in her Steam library and thought 'hey. why not... make a cute little game'
I have RPG Maker 2000, 2003, XP, MV and Visual Nover Maker from said humble bundle available, but immediately decided to go with RPG Maker XP for my 'little game' project. The reason is simple: when I was like 15-16 years old, it's the version I had dabbled with. I had absolutely no clue what I was doing back then, and the 'demo' of my 1st project, if you can even call it that, was an embarassing little thing with no sense for pace. But I had fun, learning how tile maps function, how a basic switch and event works, and to see my own designed map come to life. I eventually felt overwhelmed however, and gave up on it after a few months.
Since then I gained some confidence in myself and, I think, the ability to scale down a bit. For my first project, I do not want to create a big epic saga catering to all sorts of people, but rather a simple and fun experience for myself. I am not even sure I will share it with the world after finishing it, except maybe with a little circle. And for the record, outside the okay-ish graphics department I still have no idea what I am doing. But I am no longer giving up when hitting a roadblock, and I find it rather fun now to find solutions and / or better compromises. Scripting especially is not my strong suit, but I am thinking of maybe wishing for some Ruby beginner books for christmas this year. lol
I am a huge fan of doujinshi culture and quickly decided I wanted to make a fangame for one of my favourite series (Love Live!). I find it much easier and fun currently to build this project around an already existing story and characters whom I love so much, compared to back then when I was trying to do something completely original from scratch. Feels a bit easier with a more set direction. Because of that however I am not sure how much I can actually share, seeing how the game doesn't revolve around my own characters, but if it's okay I would like to share some of the sprite and pixel art work I am doing at least.
Eventually I want to create games with my original characters and story - but this first project of mine is supposed to be my own learning playground, to get the hang of the RPG Maker world while having fun with it and without pressuring myself too much about it.
It's nice to meet you!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome! Glad you were able to return to something that you enjoyed at such an early age!
Good luck on your projects!
